title: Managed Database: minimum invoice amount
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database minimum invoice amount is specified by contracted tier. Minimum positive monthly invoice total; USD decimal, smaller totals carry forward.

| Contracted tier | Minimum invoice amount |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | 0.5 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | 0.5 |

## Tier comparison
For minimum invoice amount, Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore and Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore use the same declared value of 0.5.
